task: You are at a noisy café and didn't catch what someone said. Ask them to repeat it.
say: Reckon it'll clear up by the arvo?
zh: 你在嘈杂的咖啡店，没听清对方说什么。请对方再说一遍。对方说：“你觉得下午天会放晴吗？”
example: Sorry, what was that? It's a bit noisy in here. I didn't quite catch it.

task: A friend invites you to dinner. Accept and ask a question.
say: Want to come over for dinner on Saturday?
zh: 朋友邀请你吃晚饭。接受，再问一个问题。对方说：“周六来我家吃晚饭吧？”
example: I'd love to, thanks! What time works? And can I bring anything?

task: A neighbour ends your chat. Close the chat nicely.
say: Anyway, I'd better get back to it.
zh: 邻居要结束聊天了。友好地结束对话。对方说：“好啦，我得回去干活了。”
example: Yeah, me too. Good to see you! Catch you later.

task: Your name is Lei. Someone says it wrong. Correct them gently.
say: Nice to meet you, Lee.
zh: 你叫 Lei，对方念错了你的名字。温和地纠正。对方说：“很高兴认识你，Lee。”
example: Nice to meet you too! It's Lei, actually, rhymes with day. Easy mistake.

task: Someone offers you a drink with a slang word. You're not sure what it means. Check, then answer.
say: Want a cuppa?
zh: 有人用俚语问你要不要喝东西，你不确定意思。确认一下，再回答。对方说：“来杯茶吗？”
example: Yes please! Sorry, is a cuppa just tea, or coffee too? I'd love a tea if that's easy.

task: Someone greets you warmly, but you have forgotten their name. Greet them and ask for their name nicely.
say: Hey! Great to see you again!
zh: 有人热情地跟你打招呼，但你忘了对方的名字。打招呼，再礼貌地问对方名字。对方说：“嘿！又见到你了，真好！”
example: Hey, you too! Sorry, remind me of your name again? I'm terrible with names.

task: A colleague invites you to Friday drinks. Decline nicely.
say: We're doing drinks after work on Friday. You keen?
zh: 同事邀请你周五下班后去喝一杯。友好地拒绝。对方说：“我们周五下班后去喝一杯，你去吗？”
example: Ah, I'd love to, but I've got family stuff on this Friday. Count me in next time, though!

task: Someone asks your age. You'd rather not say. Deflect with humour.
say: How old are you, if you don't mind me asking?
zh: 有人问你的年龄，你不想说。幽默地岔开。对方说：“冒昧问一下，你多大了？”
example: Ha, let's just say I'm old enough to remember dial-up internet! Why, do I look tired today?

task: A friend introduces someone. You want to say the name correctly. Check the name.
say: This is my mate, Tamati.
zh: 朋友介绍一个人给你认识，你想把名字念对。确认一下名字。对方说：“这是我朋友 Tamati。”
example: Hi, nice to meet you. Sorry, was it Tamati? I just want to make sure I'm saying it right.

task: Someone uses a slang word you don't know. Ask what it means.
say: Don't use that printer, it's totally munted.
zh: 有人用了一个你不懂的俚语。问是什么意思。对方说：“别用那台打印机，彻底坏了。”
example: Sorry, munted? I haven't heard that one before. Does it mean broken?

task: You meet a neighbour at the supermarket. They end the chat. Close it with a light joke.
say: Anyway, I'll let you get on.
zh: 你在超市遇到邻居，对方要结束聊天。用一句轻松的玩笑结束。对方说：“好啦，不耽误你了。”
example: Yeah, I'd better get this ice cream home before it melts! Good seeing you.

task: There is an awkward silence at a work lunch. Break it with a new topic.
say: So... yeah.
zh: 工作午餐时出现了尴尬的沉默。用一个新话题打破沉默。对方说：“所以……嗯。”
example: So, got anything planned for the weekend? I need some ideas, I've run out.

task: Someone asks how much you earn. Deflect in a friendly way and turn the chat back to them.
say: So how much do you get paid in IT? Must be good money.
zh: 有人问你挣多少钱。友好地岔开，再把话题转回对方。对方说：“你做 IT 挣多少钱？肯定很多吧。”
example: Ha, not as much as people think! It's a decent living, though. Why, are you thinking of getting into IT?

task: Someone asks how much rent you pay. Answer vaguely and keep it friendly.
say: What are you paying for rent at your place?
zh: 有人问你房租多少。含糊地回答，保持友好。对方说：“你那边房租多少钱？”
example: Too much, like everyone! It's about normal for the area. Why, are you thinking of moving?

task: You said 'I'm boring' when you meant 'I'm bored'. The other person laughs. Fix it with humour.
say: Oh, I'm sure you're not boring!
zh: 你想说“我很无聊（bored）”，却说成了“我很没意思（boring）”。对方笑了。幽默地纠正。对方说：“哦，我相信你一点都不无趣！”
example: Ha, sorry, I meant bored! Although my friends would probably say both.

task: Someone uses a Kiwi phrase you don't fully understand. Check the meaning.
say: Don't stress about the deadline. She'll be right.
zh: 有人用了一句你不太明白的新西兰俗语。确认一下意思。对方说：“别为截止日期担心，会没事的。”
example: Sorry, she'll be right? Does that mean it'll all work out fine? I hope you're right!

task: Someone invites you to their hard boxing class. Decline with humour.
say: You should come to my boxing class sometime!
zh: 有人邀请你去上很累的拳击课。幽默地拒绝。对方说：“你哪天来上我的拳击课吧！”
example: Ha, I'd last about five minutes! Maybe I'll start with yoga and work my way up.

task: Your neighbour has finished a long story at the fence. You need to pick up the kids. End the chat politely.
say: So yeah, that's the whole saga with the hedge.
zh: 邻居在篱笆边讲完了一个长故事，你得去接孩子。礼貌地结束对话。对方说：“所以啊，这就是树篱的整个来龙去脉。”
example: Wow, what a saga. Sorry, I've got to run and grab the kids, but let me know how it goes!

task: You still don't understand what someone means after they repeat it. Ask for clarification.
say: I said, are you coming to the thing on Friday?
zh: 对方重复了一遍，你还是没明白。请对方说清楚。对方说：“我是说，你周五来参加那个活动吗？”
example: Sorry, which thing on Friday? I think I've missed something. Is it a work thing?

task: Someone asks when you are going to have kids. Deflect lightly with humour.
say: So when are you two going to have kids?
zh: 有人问你们什么时候要孩子。用幽默轻松地岔开。对方说：“你们俩打算什么时候要孩子？”
example: Ha, you sound like my mum! We'll see. For now we're very happy with our spoiled cat.

task: Someone asks a slightly awkward question about why you left your home country. Answer positively and keep it light.
say: Why did you leave China? Was it hard there?
zh: 有人问你为什么离开中国，问题有点尴尬。积极、轻松地回答。对方说：“你为什么离开中国？那边生活很难吗？”
example: Not at all, I really miss it. I came here to study and ended up loving it. Life just sort of happened.

task: At a BBQ, someone has been talking about their deck for ages. Leave the chat politely.
say: And then the council said it needed another inspection. Can you believe it?
zh: 烧烤聚会上，有人一直在讲他家露台的事。礼貌地离开对话。对方说：“然后市政府又说要再检查一次，你敢信吗？”
example: That sounds so frustrating. Sorry, I've just seen my friend arrive. I'll catch you later and hear how it ends!

task: You called the host's dinner interesting, and they think you don't like it. Fix it.
say: Interesting? Oh no, you don't like it?
zh: 你说主人做的菜很“interesting”，对方以为你不喜欢。纠正一下。对方说：“有意思？哦不，你不喜欢吗？”
example: No, no, I love it! Sorry, wrong word. I meant it's new to me, in a good way. Can I get the recipe?

task: Your name is Qing. Someone says it wrong for the second time. Correct them kindly with a tip.
say: Thanks, Kwing!
zh: 你叫 Qing，对方第二次念错。友善地纠正，并给一个小提示。对方说：“谢谢，Kwing！”
example: Ha, almost! It's Qing, said like Ching. The Q trips everyone up, don't worry.

task: A friend invites you to lunch, but you are busy. Decline and suggest another day.
say: Want to grab lunch tomorrow?
zh: 朋友约你吃午饭，但你没空。拒绝，并提议改天。对方说：“明天一起吃午饭吗？”
example: Tomorrow's tricky, I'm in meetings all day. How about Thursday? I'm free from twelve.

task: At a party, someone keeps pushing you to drink. Decline politely and stay friendly.
say: Come on, just have one beer!
zh: 派对上有人一直劝你喝酒。礼貌地拒绝，保持友好。对方说：“来嘛，就喝一瓶啤酒！”
example: Thanks, but I'm driving tonight. I'll grab a lemonade instead. Next time, I promise!

task: You are with your partner Lin and meet someone whose name you've forgotten. Introduce your partner so they say their own name.
say: Hi there! Fancy seeing you here.
zh: 你和伴侣 Lin 在一起，遇到一个你忘了名字的人。介绍你的伴侣，让对方自己说出名字。对方说：“嗨！真巧在这儿碰到你。”
example: Hey, great to see you! Have you met my partner, Lin?

task: Someone guesses your nationality wrongly. Correct them lightly and keep chatting.
say: So are you Japanese or Chinese?
zh: 有人猜错了你的国籍。轻松地纠正，并继续聊下去。对方说：“你是日本人还是中国人？”
example: Chinese, from {hometown}. Easy to mix up! Have you ever been over to Asia?

task: Someone speaks fast with lots of slang. Ask them to explain without feeling embarrassed.
say: Yeah nah, it'll be chocka down the Mount by smoko.
zh: 有人说得很快，还用了很多俚语。大方地请对方解释。对方说：“嗯不会，到茶歇时间 Mount 那边就挤满人了。”
example: Sorry, you lost me there! Are you saying the Mount will be busy? And what's smoko?

task: Someone remembers your name and your trip, but you've forgotten their name. Own up with humour.
say: Hey Lei! How was Rotorua?
zh: 对方记得你的名字和你的旅行，但你忘了对方的名字。幽默地坦白。对方说：“嘿 Lei！罗托鲁瓦玩得怎么样？”
example: It was great, thanks! Okay, this is embarrassing, but I've completely forgotten your name. I remember your dog's name, though!

task: You are in a slow lift with your manager and it's quiet. Keep the chat going.
say: Slow lift, eh?
zh: 你和经理在一部很慢的电梯里，气氛很安静。把聊天继续下去。对方说：“电梯好慢啊？”
example: Painfully slow! I swear the stairs are quicker. Got a busy afternoon?

task: Someone asks if you send money home. It's personal. Deflect politely and change the topic.
say: Do you send money back home to your family?
zh: 有人问你是否给家里寄钱，这是私事。礼貌地岔开，换个话题。对方说：“你会给家里人寄钱吗？”
example: Ha, that's a bit of a personal one! Let's just say my mum's always happy when I call. How's your family doing?

task: A neighbour starts a long chat while you are in your pyjamas getting the mail. Leave with humour.
say: Oh, while I've got you, did I tell you about our trip to Fiji?
zh: 你穿着睡衣出来拿信，邻居开始跟你长聊。幽默地脱身。对方说：“哦，正好碰到你，我跟你说过我们去斐济的事吗？”
example: Ha, I'd love to hear it, but I'm standing out here in my pyjamas! Let's catch up properly on the weekend.

task: You called someone's husband by the wrong name. Fix it with humour.
say: Ha, it's Mark, not Matt!
zh: 你叫错了对方丈夫的名字。幽默地纠正。对方说：“哈，是 Mark，不是 Matt！”
example: Oh, sorry, Mark! I knew it was something with an M. Don't worry, it's locked in now.

task: A friend invites you to a quiz night that goes late. Accept, but say you may leave early.
say: Come to our quiz night! It usually goes till midnight.
zh: 朋友邀请你参加一个很晚结束的知识竞赛之夜。接受，但说明你可能早走。对方说：“来参加我们的问答之夜吧！一般要到半夜。”
example: Sounds fun, count me in! I might sneak off a bit early, though. I've got an early start the next day.

task: Everyone laughs at a joke you didn't understand. Admit it honestly with humour.
say: Get it? Because he's from Gore!
zh: 大家都在笑一个你没听懂的笑话。幽默、诚实地承认。对方说：“懂了吗？因为他是 Gore 来的！”
example: Ha, I'm going to be honest, that one went right over my head. What's the deal with Gore?

task: Someone at a party doesn't know anyone, and you want to move on. Introduce them to a friend, then leave.
say: I don't really know anyone here, to be honest.
zh: 派对上有人谁都不认识，而你想去别处。把对方介绍给你的朋友，然后离开。对方说：“说实话，我在这儿谁都不认识。”
example: Oh, come and meet my mate Jess, she knows everyone. Jess, this is Tom. He's into mountain biking too. I'll grab us some drinks.

task: Someone invites you to a sales event you have no interest in. Decline clearly but kindly.
say: My cousin's selling these health supplements. Want to come to an info evening?
zh: 有人邀请你参加一个你完全不感兴趣的推销活动。明确但友善地拒绝。对方说：“我表妹在卖保健品，想来参加个介绍会吗？”
example: Ah, thanks for thinking of me, but it's not really my thing. Hope it goes well for her, though!

task: You mixed someone up with another person and got their job wrong. Fix it with humour and show interest.
say: No, I'm a nurse, not a teacher!
zh: 你把对方和别人搞混了，说错了他的工作。幽默地纠正，并表示兴趣。对方说：“不是，我是护士，不是老师！”
example: Oh no, sorry! I've totally mixed you up with someone else. A nurse, that's a tough job. Which hospital are you at?

task: You are leaving a party, but someone starts another story. Leave warmly.
say: Oh wait, I haven't even told you about the second time it happened!
zh: 你要离开派对，但有人又开始讲另一个故事。热情地告别。对方说：“等等，我还没跟你说第二次发生的事呢！”
example: Ha, I'll have to hear part two next time! My Uber's just pulled up. Great chatting, honestly.
